Our Forward Deployed team works between our customers and our product. They take a customer’s whole support operation (the tickets, the systems, the policies) and turn it into AI agents that resolve real customer queries in production.

As an FDE intern, you’ll be part of that team from day one, not on a side project. The workflows you build will go live and handle real conversations for some of the largest fintech and healthtech companies in the US and Australia. You’ll have close support from the team and real ownership of the work you take on.

Day to day, you’ll:

* Dig into customers’ support tickets and data to find where AI can fully resolve queries, and where it can’t yet
* Build, test, and refine AI workflows from first draft through to production
* Help connect workflows to customer systems through APIs, and test integrations before they go live
* Join customer calls, share what you’ve found, and own defined parts of an implementation
* Use Claude Code and other AI tools to speed up analysis, build internal tooling, and improve how the team works

You’ll leave knowing how AI agents are deployed end to end at scale in regulated industries. You’ll also have hands-on skills in workflow design, API integrations, testing and evaluation, and LLM fundamentals, and experience turning a customer’s messy real-world problem into a working solution.

**We’d love to talk if you**

* Are curious and learn fast. You pick up new tools quickly and enjoy figuring things out.
* Are technically confident. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you’re comfortable reading API docs and working with data.
* Sweat the details. You notice when something’s off, ask good questions, and follow through.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people alike.
* Are genuinely interested in AI. It’s a bonus if you’ve experimented with LLMs or built something with AI tools on your own.

**What's unique about this opportunity?**
-----------------------------------------

**A culture that's genuinely different.** Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

**A front-row seat to building something meaningful.** We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.

**Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar.** Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.

**We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too.** Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

**Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii.** Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

**A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops.** We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.

If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Program Manager to lead and drive key editorial initiatives that integrate cutting-edge AI technologies into our customer-facing products in Asia and Emerging Markets (AEM). This role is pivotal in ensuring that our AI editorial projects align with the company’s strategic objectives and are delivered with the highest standards of quality and efficiency. This role will work collaboratively with our global partners, including product, labs, technology, and editorial. The successful candidate will have a strong interest in AI technologies, excel in project planning, problem solving, time management, stakeholder communication, risk management, and quality assurance.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

In this opportunity as an AI Editorial Senior Program Manager– AEM, you will:

  

* **Lead editorial program planning** across CoCounsel Legal, Practical Law, and Westlaw by creating project roadmaps, overseeing resource planning, managing schedules, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
* **Manage the creation and maintenance** of gold data tests supporting AEM AI evaluation initiatives.
* **Communicate with leadership** by providing regular reports and updates on progress toward deliverables.
* **Facilitate** effective communication and collaboration across diverse teams.
* **Manage risk** by proactively identifying potential project risks, developing comprehensive mitigation strategies, and addressing issues promptly to maintain project momentum and efficiency.
* **Assure high quality** by maintaining and troubleshooting deliverables, supporting testing and validation of AI outputs and coordinating feedback to product, engineering and data science partners, and implementing continuous improvement processes to enhance editorial workflows.

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

You’re a fit for the role of AI Editorial Senior Program Manager– AEM if you have the following required qualifications:

  

* Law degree from an accredited school.
* At least two years' experience working at a law firm or in an in-house legal team.
* Proven project management experience, ideally within editorial or AI technology contexts.
* Strong leadership skills with a strategic mindset.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate complex concepts clearly to various audiences.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including technical and non-technical members.
* Comfortable managing relationships with senior stakeholders, including navigating competing priorities and difficult conversations.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for leveraging AI in editorial processes.
Ability and willingness to work flexibly across time zones, including North American and the Asia-Pacific region, as needed to support global stakeholders.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* A good understanding of existing AI legal tools and how to use them.
* A good understanding of Westlaw and CoCounsel Legal, and their current AI solutions,
* Excellent problem-solving skills with proven analytical skills.
* A proven ability to build relationships and to influence individuals to action.
Adaptability and comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Analytics & Sales Program offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in financial markets, Bloomberg technology, and client engagement while developing a foundation for a long-term career within Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business.

You will begin your career in Analytics, where you'll work directly with Bloomberg Professional Services clients across the global financial community. In our Analytics business, you will provide 24/7 support to Bloomberg users around the world and across multiple industries. Through Instant Bloomberg (IB) chat, you'll answer client questions, solve complex workflow challenges, and help clients maximize the value of Bloomberg's products and solutions.

On any given day, our teams respond to tens of thousands of client inquiries in over 15 languages. From helping portfolio managers analyze risk to supporting traders as they uncover new sources of market liquidity, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of financial workflows while developing deep product, market, and client expertise.

As Bloomberg continues to innovate, you'll partner with clients to introduce new products, deliver training, support onboarding and product rollouts, and help organizations utilize technology more effectively. You'll also collaborate closely with Sales teams on strategic client initiatives, building the skills and relationship management capabilities that prepare you for future opportunities across Financial Solutions.

  

As your expertise grows, you'll have the opportunity to progress into Sales, the most common career path within the program. In Sales, you'll become a trusted advisor to clients, building long-term relationships, understanding business goals and workflows, and identifying opportunities to deliver Bloomberg solutions while driving business growth.

**What's In It for You?**

**Industry-Leading Training**

From day one, you'll participate in one of the industry's most comprehensive training programs, building a foundation in financial markets, asset classes, Bloomberg technology, and client workflows.

**Client Exposure from Day One**

After training, you'll join one of our Analytics teams, where you'll continue learning through hands-on client exposure, mentorship, and specialized asset class and workflow training. Every client interaction is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, develop your problem-solving skills, and build confidence as a trusted advisor.

**Long-Term Career Growth**

The Analytics & Sales Program is designed to accelerate your professional development. As your knowledge and experience grow, so do your opportunities. Most participants progress into Sales, where they build long-term client relationships and drive business growth, while others pursue specialist client-facing, product or leadership roles across Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business.

**Who You Are**

You are intellectually curious, client-focused, and energized by financial markets. You enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and understanding the drivers behind market-moving events. A strong communicator and relationship builder, you thrive in fast-paced environments, are passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, and are motivated to build a long-term career helping clients solve challenges and achieve their business goals.

* A bachelor's degree (or above) or relevant work experience.

* Demonstrated interest in financial markets and the fintech industry, with a strong desire to work directly with clients and a curiosity about their businesses, challenges, and workflows.
* Strong multitasking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Ambition to build a long-term, client-facing career across Financial Solutions, with a strong interest in relationship management and sales.
* **Business fluency in English plus** **Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai or Bahasa Indonesian**; supported by strong communication skills and the ability to build credibility with clients.
* Interest in innovative technologies and their potential to enhance workflows and efficiencies.
* **Legal authorization to work full-time and will not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.**
* Willingness and ability to travel around the country to met the business needs of our clients.
* Flexibility to occasionally work weekends or on bank/public/federal holiday (weekday off in lieu).

**We’d love to see:**

* Demonstrated practical exposure to Python or other coding languages preferably.
* Previous experience in client relationship management or customer support roles.
* Beginner to intermediate experience with Excel and/or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
* With 1-3 years of full-time work experience in the financial market or financial services industry, or in client-facing/relationship management/sales/consulting role.
